policy.targetCount: approximately 5–15 when grounded evidence supports it

items.name: existingCustomerCanSignIn
items.title: An existing Android customer can sign in and reach their profile
items.businessValue: Authentication does not prevent existing customers from entering the product.
items.risk: Business guarantee regresses or becomes inconclusive.
items.requiredValidation: Replay on the current target revision; committed status alone is not execution proof.

items.name: profileReachable
items.title: Profile remains reachable
items.businessValue: Protect access to the observed Profile product surface.
items.risk: Observed UI behavior is not covered by a reviewed Task or release contract.
items.requiredValidation: Author reusable Tasks for observed transitions, then compile and replay the contract against the real target.

review.instructions: Approve, reject, defer, reprioritize, or constrain pending items before generation. Existing committed contracts remain accepted but still require current replay evidence.
